summary: Five skiers/snowboarders missing after leaving Blue Sky Basin; ski patrol found 3, VMRG snowmobile teams took the other 2 (unfamiliar with area, no survival gear) to Vail Pass; out ~2:30 a.m. Jan 19
location: Blue Sky Basin / Lime Creek drainage
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group + Vail Ski Patrol
notes: Jan-Feb-2016 VMRG mission digest; victims = the 2 VMRG-evacuated subjects.
